strategy.thesis: Europe's first dedicated semiconductor VC; invests pre-seed/seed into semiconductors (compute & electronics), photonics (connectivity & sensing) and advanced materials (equipment, design tools & metrology), addressing the gap where Europe has R&D talent and industrial heritage but lacked specialist early-stage chip capital.

Strategic LPs include GlobalFoundries and Radiant Opto-Electronics.
